project_info.theme: Rockstar x be driver motivation campaign

main_subject.detail: A bold collaboration poster with a smiling young male be rider seated on a yellow scooter, holding a giant condensation-covered Rockstar energy drink can in one hand and a smartphone with a five-star rating graphic in the other, against a city-road backdrop.
main_subject.style: Photoreal endorsement poster with oversized product hero and urban campaign energy

Center: young male be rider in yellow-blue uniform sitting on a yellow scooter.

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image to preserve rider identity, can scale, and the smartphone star overlay.
Keep all visible text exactly as shown.
Maintain the oversized can perspective and central road composition.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square be x Rockstar endorsement poster. Use a bright yellow sky over a city-road background. At the top center place the be logo and 'ROCKSTAR NƯỚC TĂNG LỰC'. Add the black headline 'TIẾP SỨC BỀN' and a large blue bar reading 'VỮNG CHUỖI 5 SAO'. In the center, show a smiling young male be rider seated on a yellow scooter. Have him hold a giant condensation-covered Rockstar can toward the camera on the left and a smartphone with a five-star rating graphic on the right. Technical style: photoreal brand-collab endorsement poster, bright commercial outdoor lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark mood, incorrect logos, blurry face, wrong can label, low resolution, distorted hands, watermark, signature
